research_question: Do signals derived from the already-trained frozen FC autoencoder provide incremental information beyond the Stage 14 SUMMARY_ONLY supervised representation?

feature_definitions.reconstruction_mse: Mean of the 30 squared residuals, where residual is frozen-FC reconstruction minus input.
feature_definitions.early_half_reconstruction_mse: Mean squared residual over positions 0 through 14.
feature_definitions.late_half_reconstruction_mse: Mean squared residual over positions 15 through 29.
feature_definitions.latent_1: First coordinate of the frozen four-unit ReLU encoder bottleneck.
feature_definitions.latent_2: Second coordinate of the frozen four-unit ReLU encoder bottleneck.
feature_definitions.latent_3: Third coordinate of the frozen four-unit ReLU encoder bottleneck.
feature_definitions.latent_4: Fourth coordinate of the frozen four-unit ReLU encoder bottleneck.

considered_but_excluded.pointwise_error_standard_deviation: Excluded to keep the complete set at 10; it is strongly tied to MSE/MAE and adds no distinct error-location information.
considered_but_excluded.maximum_error_location: Excluded because a position index has fragile semantics across pooled calendar windows and would add a difficult-to-interpret ordinal feature.

representations.FC_ONLY: Six reconstruction features plus four frozen latent coordinates.
representations.SUMMARY_PLUS_RECON: Stage 14 summaries plus six reconstruction features.
representations.SUMMARY_PLUS_FC: Stage 14 summaries plus all ten FC-derived features; this is the central full hybrid comparison.

threshold_policy: For each representation, maximize positive-class F1 on validation separately at window level and after mean-window-probability customer aggregation.
primary_comparison: Customer-level ROC-AUC and average precision for SUMMARY_PLUS_FC minus SUMMARY_ONLY.
hybrid_interpretation_policy: Permutation importance is computed for the best pre-registered SUMMARY_PLUS representation, but features are not redesigned from the result.

bootstrap_policy.interval: 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of paired metric deltas

leakage_controls: Frozen FC checkpoint only; no retraining or adaptation.
Feature extraction does not use FLAG or any label-derived quantity.
Customer/window identifiers are alignment metadata only.
Existing preprocessing and customer split are unchanged.
Only train and validation windows may be loaded.
Test features, labels, predictions, and historical test metrics are prohibited.
inherited_validation_reuse_limitation: The frozen Stage 4 checkpoint was selected at epoch 30 using reconstruction MSE on FLAG=0 validation windows. Stage 15 performs no new FC fitting and does not use the validation-derived P95 threshold, but every FC-derived feature inherits this historical normal-validation exposure. Hybrid validation deltas may therefore be optimistic and are diagnostic rather than an independent external estimate.
test_policy: CLOSED. TEST NOT ACCESSED DURING STAGE 15.
feature_revision_policy: No FC-derived feature may be added, removed, or redefined after Stage 15 validation scoring unless a documented implementation bug is found.
